page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each vCPU maps directly to a physical core, eliminating hyperthreading resource sharing.

The instance is configured with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring reliance on network-attached storage solutions. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

This hardware profile offers high memory capacity and dedicated CPU execution, which is advantageous for memory-intensive workloads that require predictable compute performance. The lack of hyperthreading ensures dedicated execution resources per vCPU but reduces the total concurrent thread count compared to hyperthreaded alternatives. The absence of local storage and GPU hardware makes it less suitable for local-disk-heavy databases or machine learning acceleration. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-intensive data processing applications.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, operating with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration that avoids hyperthreading resource contention. The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. This resource configuration is designed for memory-intensive enterprise applications, in-memory databases, and large-scale data analytics where dedicated CPU execution and high memory capacity are critical.
